title: Lowpoly Concrete Forest Left Default Example
description: Lowpoly Concrete Forest Left Default Example
summary: Replaced the lowpoly editor default example mesh (previously a procedural Rock icosphere) with the tessellated hexagonal-cut concrete forest left BREP solid from the CAD play fixture. Added `HalfedgeMesh::from_indexed_triangles`, embedded the centered halfedge mesh in `lowpoly/example/concrete-forest-left.mesh.json`, updated `default_fixture()` and `default.lowpoly.json`, adjusted the default world camera for the larger building-scale mesh, and added an integration test plus ticket export script to regenerate the mesh asset from CAD tessellation.
